1.sahih_international: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

2.sahih_international: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
2.pickthall: Who are humble in their prayers,
2.yusuf_ali: Those who humble themselves in their prayers;
2.shakir: Who are humble in their prayers,
2.muhammad_sarwar: who are submissive to God in their prayers,
2.mohsin_khan: Those who offer their Salat (prayers) with all solemnity and full submissiveness.
2.arberry: who in their prayers are humble

3.sahih_international: And they who turn away from ill speech
3.shakir: And who keep aloof from what is vain,
3.mohsin_khan: And those who turn away from Al-Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk, falsehood, and all that Allah has forbidden).
3.arberry: and from idle talk turn away

4.sahih_international: And they who are observant of zakah
4.pickthall: And who are payers of the poor-due;
4.yusuf_ali: Who are active in deeds of charity;
4.shakir: And who are givers of poor-rate,
4.mohsin_khan: And those who pay the Zakat.

5.sahih_international: And they who guard their private parts
5.shakir: And who guard their private parts,
5.mohsin_khan: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts, from illegal sexual acts)

6.sahih_international: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
6.pickthall: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,
6.yusuf_ali: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame,
6.shakir: Except before their mates or those whom their right hands possess, for they surely are not blameable,
6.muhammad_sarwar: except with their spouses and slave-girls. The practice of carnal relations is lawful with them.
6.mohsin_khan: Except from their wives or (the captives and slaves) that their right hands possess, for then, they are free from blame;
6.arberry: save from their wives and what their right hands own then being not blameworthy

7.sahih_international: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
7.pickthall: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -
7.yusuf_ali: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors;-
7.shakir: But whoever seeks to go beyond that, these are they that exceed the limits;
7.muhammad_sarwar: Those who desire to go beyond such limits they commit transgression,
7.mohsin_khan: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors;
7.arberry: (but whosoever seeks after more than that, those are the transgressors)

8.sahih_international: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
8.pickthall: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,
8.yusuf_ali: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants;
8.shakir: And those who are keepers of their trusts and their covenant,
8.muhammad_sarwar: those who are true to their trust,
8.mohsin_khan: Those who are faithfully true to their Amanat (all the duties which Allah has ordained, honesty, moral responsibility and trusts etc.) and to their covenants;
8.arberry: and who preserve their trusts and their covenant

9.sahih_international: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
9.pickthall: And who pay heed to their prayers.
9.shakir: And those who keep a guard on their prayers;
9.mohsin_khan: And those who strictly guard their (five compulsory congregational) Salawat (prayers) (at their fixed stated hours).

10.shakir: These are they who are the heirs,
10.muhammad_sarwar: and who are steadfast in their prayer.

11.sahih_international: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
11.pickthall: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.
11.yusuf_ali: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
11.shakir: Who shall inherit the Paradise; they shall abide therein.
11.muhammad_sarwar: These are the heirs of Paradise wherein they will live forever.
11.mohsin_khan: Who shall inherit the Firdaus (Paradise). They shall dwell therein forever.
11.arberry: who shall inherit Paradise therein dwelling forever.

12.sahih_international: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
12.pickthall: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
12.yusuf_ali: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
12.shakir: And certainly We created man of an extract of clay,
12.muhammad_sarwar: We have created the human being from an extract of clay
12.mohsin_khan: And indeed We created man (Adam) out of an extract of clay (water and earth).
12.arberry: We created man of an extraction of clay,

13.sahih_international: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.
13.pickthall: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;
13.yusuf_ali: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
13.shakir: Then We made him a small seed in a firm resting-place,
13.muhammad_sarwar: which was then turned into a living germ and placed in safe depository.
13.mohsin_khan: Thereafter We made him (the offspring of Adam) as a Nutfah (mixed drops of the male and female sexual discharge) (and lodged it) in a safe lodging (womb of the woman).
13.arberry: then We set him, a drop, in a receptacle secure,

14.sahih_international: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
14.pickthall: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!
14.yusuf_ali: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be Allah, the best to create!
14.shakir: Then We made the seed a clot, then We made the clot a lump of flesh, then We made (in) the lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, then We caused it to grow into another creation, so blessed be Allah, the best of the creators.
14.muhammad_sarwar: The living germ, then, was turned into a shapeless lump of flesh from which bones were formed. The bones, then, were covered with flesh. At this stage, We caused it to become another creature. All blessings belong to God, the best Creator.
14.mohsin_khan: Then We made the Nutfah into a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood), then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators.
14.arberry: then We created of the drop a clot then We created of the clot a tissue then We created of the tissue bones then We garmented the bones in flesh; thereafter We produced him as another creature. So blessed be God, the fairest of creators!

15.sahih_international: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
15.pickthall: Then lo! after that ye surely die.
15.yusuf_ali: After that, at length ye will die
15.shakir: Then after that you will most surely die.
15.mohsin_khan: After that, surely, you will die.
15.arberry: Then after that you shall surely die,

16.sahih_international: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
16.pickthall: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).
16.yusuf_ali: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up.
16.shakir: Then surely on the day of resurrection you shall be raised.
16.muhammad_sarwar: and you will be brought back to life again on the Day of Resurrection.
16.mohsin_khan: Then (again), surely, you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection.
16.arberry: then on the Day of Resurrection you shall surely be raised up.

17.sahih_international: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
17.pickthall: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.
17.yusuf_ali: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation.
17.shakir: And certainly We made above you seven heavens; and never are We heedless of creation.
17.muhammad_sarwar: We have created seven heavens above you and have never been neglectful to Our Creation.
17.mohsin_khan: And indeed We have created above you seven heavens (one over the other), and We are never unaware of the creation.
17.arberry: And We created above you seven ways, and We were not heedless of creation.

18.sahih_international: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
18.pickthall: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.
18.yusuf_ali: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease).
18.shakir: And We send down water from the cloud according to a measure, then We cause it to settle in the earth, and most surely We are able to carry it away.
18.muhammad_sarwar: We have sent a measure of water from the sky to stay on earth and We have the power to take it away.
18.mohsin_khan: And We sent down from the sky water (rain) in (due) measure, and We gave it lodging in the earth, and verily, We are Able to take it away.
18.arberry: And We sent down out of heaven water in measure and lodged it in the earth; and We are able to take it away.

19.sahih_international: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
19.pickthall: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;
19.yusuf_ali: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment),-
19.shakir: Then We cause to grow thereby gardens of palm trees and grapes for you; you have in them many fruits and from them do you eat;
19.muhammad_sarwar: We have established for you gardens of palm trees and vineyards with this water with many fruits for you to consume.
19.mohsin_khan: Then We brought forth for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you, and whereof you eat.
19.arberry: Then We produced for you therewith gardens of palms and vines wherein are many fruits for you, and of them you eat,

20.sahih_international: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.
20.pickthall: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.
20.yusuf_ali: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food.
20.shakir: And a tree that grows out of Mount Sinai which produces oil and a condiment for those who eat.
20.muhammad_sarwar: We have also created for you the tree that grows on Mount Sinai which produces oil and relish for those who use it.
20.mohsin_khan: And a tree (olive) that springs forth from Mount Sinai, that grows oil, and (it is a) relish for the eaters.
20.arberry: and a tree issuing from the Mount of Sinai that bears oil and seasoning for all to eat.

21.sahih_international: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
21.pickthall: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;
21.yusuf_ali: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat;
21.shakir: And most surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle: We make you to drink of what is in their bellies, and you have in them many advantages and of them you eat,
21.muhammad_sarwar: There is a lesson for you concerning cattle. We provide you with drink from their bellies and many other benefits. You can consume them as meat.
21.mohsin_khan: And Verily! In the cattle there is indeed a lesson for you. We give you to drink (milk) of that which is in their bellies. And there are, in them, numerous (other) benefits for you, and of them you eat.
21.arberry: And surely in the cattle there is a lesson for you; We give you to drink of what is in their bellies, and many uses there are in them for you, and of them you eat;

22.sahih_international: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
22.pickthall: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.
22.yusuf_ali: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride.
22.shakir: And on them and on the ships you are borne.
22.muhammad_sarwar: You are carried by the animals on land and by the ships in the sea.
22.mohsin_khan: And on them, and on ships you are carried.
22.arberry: and upon them, and on the ships, you are borne.

23.sahih_international: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
23.pickthall: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
23.yusuf_ali: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship Allah! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
23.shakir: And certainly We sent Nuh to his people, and he said: O my people! serve Allah, you have no god other than Him; will you not then guard (against evil)?
23.muhammad_sarwar: We sent Noah to his people who said, "My people, worship God for He is your only Lord. Will you then not have fear of Him?"
23.mohsin_khan: And indeed We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people, and he said: "O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other Ilah (God) but Him (Islamic Monotheism). Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His Punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?"
23.arberry: And We sent Noah to his people; and he, said, 'O my people, serve God! You have no god other than He. Will you not be godfearing?"

24.sahih_international: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
24.pickthall: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.
24.yusuf_ali: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if Allah had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old."
24.shakir: And the chiefs of those who disbelieved from among his people said: He is nothing but a mortal like yourselves who desires that he may have superiority over you, and if Allah had pleased, He could certainly have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our fathers of yore:
24.muhammad_sarwar: The chiefs of the unbelievers said to the others, "He is a mere mortal like you. He wants only to be superior to you. Had God wanted He would have sent the angels (instead of him). We have never heard from our fathers anything like what he says.
24.mohsin_khan: But the chiefs of those who disbelieved among his people said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he seeks to make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing among our fathers of old.
24.arberry: Said the Council of the unbelievers of his people, 'This is naught but a mortal like yourselves, who desires to gain superiority over you. And if God willed, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of this among, our fathers, the ancients.

25.sahih_international: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
25.pickthall: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.
25.yusuf_ali: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time."
25.shakir: He is only a madman, so bear with him for a time.
25.muhammad_sarwar: He is only an insane person. Wait for some time. Perhaps he will come to his senses."
25.mohsin_khan: "He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him a while."
25.arberry: He is naught but a man bedevilled; so wait on him for a time.

26.sahih_international: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
26.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
26.yusuf_ali: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood!"
26.shakir: He said: O my Lord! help me against their calling me a liar.
26.muhammad_sarwar: Noah prayed, "Lord, help me; they have called me a liar".
26.mohsin_khan: [Nuh (Noah)] said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."
26.arberry: He said, 'O my Lord, help me, for that they cry me lies.'

27.sahih_international: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
27.pickthall: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.
27.yusuf_ali: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood).
27.shakir: So We revealed to him, saying: Make the ark before Our eyes and (according to) Our revelation; and when Our command is given and the valley overflows, take into it of every kind a pair, two, and your followers, except those among them against whom the word has gone forth, and do not speak to Me in respect of those who are unjust; surely they shall be drowned.
27.muhammad_sarwar: We inspired him, saying, "Build the Ark before Our eyes and by the instruction of Our revelation. When our decree comes to pass and water comes forth from the Oven, embark in the Ark with a pair of every kind of animals and your family except those already doomed (to perish). Do not plead with Me for the unjust; they will be drowned."
27.mohsin_khan: So We inspired him (saying): "Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our Revelation (guidance). Then, when Our Command comes, and the oven gushes forth water, take on board of each kind two (male and female), and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favour of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned.
27.arberry: Then We said to him, 'Make thou the Ark under Our eyes and as We reveal, and then, when Our command comes and the Oven boils, insert in it two of every kind and thy, family -- except for him against whom the word already has been spoken; and address Me not concerning those who have done evil; they shall be drowned.

28.sahih_international: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
28.pickthall: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
28.yusuf_ali: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong."
28.shakir: And when you are firmly seated, you and those with you, in the ark, say: All praise is due to Allah who delivered us from the unjust people:
28.muhammad_sarwar: When all of you settle in the Ark, say, "Only God Who has saved us from the unjust people deserves all praise".
28.mohsin_khan: And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who are Zalimun (i.e. oppressors, wrong-doers, polytheists, those who join others in worship with Allah, etc.).
28.arberry: Then, when thou art seated in the Ark and those with thee, say, "Praise belongs to God, who has delivered us from the people of the evildoers."

29.sahih_international: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "
29.pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
29.yusuf_ali: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
29.shakir: And say: O my Lord! cause me to disembark a blessed alighting, and Thou art the best to cause to alight.
29.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "Lord, grant us a blessed landing from the Ark; You are the One who provides the safest landing".
29.mohsin_khan: And say: "My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land."
29.arberry: And say, "'O my Lord, do Thou harbour me in a blessed harbour, for Thou art the best of harbourers."

30.sahih_international: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
30.pickthall: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.
30.yusuf_ali: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men).
30.shakir: Most surely there are signs in this, and most surely We are ever trying (men).
30.muhammad_sarwar: In this story there is enough evidence (of the Truth); thus do We try (mankind)
30.mohsin_khan: Verily, in this [what We did as regards drowning of the people of Nuh (Noah)], there are indeed Ayat (proofs, evidences, lessons, signs, etc. for men to understand), for sure We are ever putting (men) to the test.
30.arberry: Surely in that are signs, and surely We put to the test.

31.sahih_international: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
31.pickthall: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
31.yusuf_ali: Then We raised after them another generation.
31.shakir: Then We raised up after them another generation.
31.muhammad_sarwar: We brought another generation into existence after the people of Noah.
31.mohsin_khan: Then, after them, We created another generation.
31.arberry: Thereafter, after them, We produced another generation,

32.sahih_international: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
32.pickthall: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
32.yusuf_ali: And We sent to them a messenger from among themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
32.shakir: So We sent among them an apostle from among them, saying: Serve Allah, you have no god other than Him; will you not then guard (against evil)?
32.muhammad_sarwar: We sent to them a Messenger from among their own people who told them, "Worship God; He is your only Lord. Will you then not have fear of Him?"
32.mohsin_khan: And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): "Worship Allah! You have no other Ilah (God) but Him. Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His Punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?"
32.arberry: and We sent amongst them a Messenger of themselves, saying, 'Serve God! You have no god other than He. Will you not be godfearing?'

33.sahih_international: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
33.pickthall: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
33.yusuf_ali: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink.
33.shakir: And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and called the meeting of the hereafter a lie, and whom We had given plenty to enjoy in this world's life, said: This is nothing but a mortal like yourselves, eating of what you eat from and drinking of what you drink.
33.muhammad_sarwar: A group of his people who disbelieved him and had called the Day of Judgment a lie and whom We had made prosperous in this life, said, "He is a mere mortal like you. He eats and drinks as you do.
33.mohsin_khan: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and to whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink.
33.arberry: Said the Council of the unbelievers of his people, who cried lies to the encounter of the world to come, and to whom We had given ease in the present' life, 'This is naught but a mortal like yourselves, who eats of what you eat and drinks of what you drink.

34.sahih_international: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
34.pickthall: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.
34.yusuf_ali: "If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost.
34.shakir: And if you obey a mortal like yourselves, then most surely you will be losers:
34.muhammad_sarwar: If you follow a mortal like yourselves you will certainly be lost.
34.mohsin_khan: "If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily! You indeed would be losers.
34.arberry: If you obey a mortal like yourselves, then you will be losers.

35.sahih_international: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
35.pickthall: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?
35.yusuf_ali: "Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)?
35.shakir: What! does he threaten you that when you are dead and become dust and bones that you shall then be brought forth?
35.muhammad_sarwar: Does he promise you that after you die and become dust and bones you will be brought back to life again?
35.mohsin_khan: "Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive (resurrected)?
35.arberry: What, does he promise you that when you are dead, and become dust and bones, you shall be brought forth?

36.sahih_international: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
36.pickthall: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!
36.yusuf_ali: "Far, very far is that which ye are promised!
36.shakir: Far, far is that which you are threatened with.
36.muhammad_sarwar: Such a promise will never come true.
36.mohsin_khan: "Far, very far is that which you are promised.
36.arberry: Away, away with that you are promised!

37.sahih_international: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
37.pickthall: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
37.yusuf_ali: "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
37.shakir: There is naught but our life in this world; we die and we live and we shall not be raised again.
37.muhammad_sarwar: This is our only life. We live and will die but we will never be brought back to life again.
37.mohsin_khan: "There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!
37.arberry: There is nothing but our present life; we die, and we live, and we shall not be raised up.

38.sahih_international: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."
38.pickthall: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.
38.yusuf_ali: "He is only a man who invents a lie against Allah, but we are not the ones to believe in him!"
38.shakir: He is naught but a man who has forged a lie against Allah, and we are not going to believe in him.
38.muhammad_sarwar: He is only a man who invents lies against God, so have no faith in him".
38.mohsin_khan: "He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allah, but we are not going to believe in him."
38.arberry: He is naught but a man who has forged against God a lie, and we will not believe him.'

39.sahih_international: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
39.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
39.yusuf_ali: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."
39.shakir: He said: O my Lord! help me against their calling me a liar.
39.muhammad_sarwar: The Messenger prayed, "Lord, help me; they have called me a liar".
39.mohsin_khan: He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."
39.arberry: He said, 'O my Lord, help me, for that they cry me lies.'

40.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
40.pickthall: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.
40.yusuf_ali: (Allah) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry!"
40.shakir: He said: In a little while they will most certainly be repenting.
40.muhammad_sarwar: God replied, "After a very short time they will certainly regret for their deeds."
40.mohsin_khan: (Allah) said: "In a little while, they are sure to be regretful."
40.arberry: He said, 'In a little they will be remorseful.'

41.sahih_international: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
41.pickthall: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!
41.yusuf_ali: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong!
41.shakir: So the punishment overtook them in justice, and We made them as rubbish; so away with the unjust people.
41.muhammad_sarwar: A blast struck them for a just cause, and We made them look like withered leaves. God keeps the unjust people away from His mercy.
41.mohsin_khan: So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry, etc.) overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So away with the people who are Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, disobedient to His Messengers, etc.).
41.arberry: And the Cry seized them justly, and We made them as scum; so away with the people of the evildoers!

42.sahih_international: Then We produced after them other generations.
42.pickthall: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
42.yusuf_ali: Then We raised after them other generations.
42.shakir: Then We raised after them other generations.
42.muhammad_sarwar: After them We brought another generation into existence.
42.mohsin_khan: Then, after them, We created other generations.
42.arberry: Thereafter, after them, We produced other generations;

43.sahih_international: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
43.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.
43.yusuf_ali: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it).
43.shakir: No people can hasten on their doom nor can they postpone (it).
43.muhammad_sarwar: Every nation has an appointed life span.
43.mohsin_khan: No nation can anticipate their term, nor can they delay it.
43.arberry: no nation outstrips its term, nor do they put it back.

44.sahih_international: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
44.pickthall: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
44.yusuf_ali: Then sent We our messengers in succession: every time there came to a people their messenger, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe!
44.shakir: Then We sent Our apostles one after another; whenever there came to a people their apostle, they called him a liar, so We made some of them follow others and We made them stories; so away with a people who do not believe!
44.muhammad_sarwar: We sent Our messengers one after the other but whenever a Messenger would come to a nation, its people would call him a liar and We would destroy one nation after the other, thus, only their stories were left behind them. God keeps the unbelievers far away from His Mercy.
44.mohsin_khan: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession, every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them as Ahadith (the true stories for mankind to learn a lesson from them). So away with a people who believe not.
44.arberry: Then sent We Our Messengers successively; whenever its Messenger came to a nation they cried him lies, so We caused some of them to follow others, and We made them as but tales; so away with a people who do not believe!

45.sahih_international: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
45.pickthall: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant
45.yusuf_ali: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest,
45.shakir: Then We sent Musa and his brother Haroun, with Our communications and a clear authority,
45.muhammad_sarwar: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our miracles and clear authority
45.mohsin_khan: Then We sent Musa (Moses) and his brother Harun (Aaron), with Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and manifest authority,
45.arberry: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a manifest authority

46.sahih_international: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
46.pickthall: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.
46.yusuf_ali: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people.
46.shakir: To Firon and his chiefs, but they behaved haughtily and they were an insolent people.
46.muhammad_sarwar: to the Pharaoh and his nobles. But they behaved proudly and thought themselves superior people.
46.mohsin_khan: To Fir'aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord, and exalting themselves over and above the Messenger of Allah).
46.arberry: unto Pharaoh and his Council; but they waxed proud, and they were a lofty people,

47.sahih_international: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
47.pickthall: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?
47.yusuf_ali: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
47.shakir: And they said: What! shall we believe in two mortals like ourselves while their people serve us?
47.muhammad_sarwar: They said, "Should we believe in two mere mortals who are like ourselves and whose people are our slaves?"
47.mohsin_khan: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like)."
47.arberry: and they said, 'What, shall we believe two mortals like ourselves, whose people are our servants?'

48.sahih_international: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
48.pickthall: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.
48.yusuf_ali: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed.
48.shakir: So they rejected them and became of those who were destroyed.
48.muhammad_sarwar: They called them liars and consequently were destroyed.
48.mohsin_khan: So they denied them both [Musa (Moses) and Harun (Aaron)] and became of those who were destroyed.
48.arberry: So they cried them lies, and they were among the destroyed.

49.sahih_international: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
49.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.
49.yusuf_ali: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance.
49.shakir: And certainly We gave Musa the Book that they may follow a right direction.
49.muhammad_sarwar: We gave the Book to Moses so that perhaps they may have guidance.
49.mohsin_khan: And indeed We gave Musa (Moses) the Scripture, that they may be guided.
49.arberry: And We gave Moses the Book, that haply they would be guided;

50.sahih_international: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
50.pickthall: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.
50.yusuf_ali: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.
50.shakir: And We made the son of Marium and his mother a sign, and We gave them a shelter on a lofty ground having meadows and springs.
50.muhammad_sarwar: We made the son of Mary and his mother a miracle and settled them on a high land, quite secure and watered by a spring.
50.mohsin_khan: And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother as a sign, And We gave them refuge on high ground, a place of rest, security and flowing streams.
50.arberry: and We made Mary's son, and his mother, to be a sign, and gave them refuge upon a height, where was a hollow and a spring:

51.sahih_international: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.
51.pickthall: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.
51.yusuf_ali: O ye messengers! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
51.shakir: O apostles! eat of the good things and do good; surely I know what you do.
51.muhammad_sarwar: I told them, "Messengers, eat from the pure things and act righteously; I know all that you do.
51.mohsin_khan: O (you) Messengers! Eat of the Taiyibat [all kinds of Halal (legal) foods which Allah has made legal (meat of slaughtered eatable animals, milk products, fats, vegetables, fruits, etc.], and do righteous deeds. Verily! I am Well-Acquainted with what you do.
51.arberry: 'O Messengers, eat of the good things and do righteousness; surely I know the things you do.

52.sahih_international: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
52.pickthall: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.
52.yusuf_ali: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other).
52.shakir: And surely this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, therefore be careful (of your duty) to Me.
52.muhammad_sarwar: Your religion is one and I am your Lord. Have fear of Me".
52.mohsin_khan: And verily! This your religion (of Islamic Monotheism) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so keep your duty to Me.
52.arberry: Surely this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord; so fear Me.'

53.sahih_international: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
53.pickthall: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.
53.yusuf_ali: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself.
53.shakir: But they cut off their religion among themselves into sects, each part rejoicing in that which is with them.
53.muhammad_sarwar: The people divided themselves into many sects, each with their own book and each happy with whatever they had.
53.mohsin_khan: But they (men) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its belief.
53.arberry: But they split in their affair between them into sects, each party rejoicing in what is with them.

54.sahih_international: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
54.pickthall: So leave them in their error till a time.
54.yusuf_ali: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time.
54.shakir: Therefore leave them in their overwhelming ignorance till
54.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), leave them alone in their dark ignorance for an appointed time.
54.mohsin_khan: So leave them in their error for a time.
54.arberry: So leave thou them in their perplexity for a time.

55.sahih_international: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
55.pickthall: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them
55.yusuf_ali: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons,
55.shakir: Do they think that by what We aid them with of wealth and children,
55.muhammad_sarwar: Do they think that We are helping them by giving them children and property?
55.mohsin_khan: Do they think that We enlarge them in wealth and children,
55.arberry: What, do they think that We succour them with of wealth and children,

56.sahih_international: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
56.pickthall: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not.
56.yusuf_ali: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand.
56.shakir: We are hastening to them of good things? Nay, they do not perceive.
56.muhammad_sarwar: We provide them with the means of competing with each other in virtuous deeds, but they do not realize this.
56.mohsin_khan: We hasten unto them with good things (in this worldly life so that they will have no share of good things in the Hereafter)? Nay, but they perceive not.
56.arberry: We vie in good works for them? Nay, but they are not aware.

57.sahih_international: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
57.pickthall: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.
57.yusuf_ali: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
57.shakir: Surely they who from fear of their Lord are cautious,
57.muhammad_sarwar: Only those who are, out of fear of Him, humble before their Lord,
57.mohsin_khan: Verily! Those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
57.arberry: Surely those who tremble in fear of their Lord

58.sahih_international: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
58.pickthall: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
58.yusuf_ali: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord;
58.shakir: And those who believe in the communications of their Lord,
58.muhammad_sarwar: who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
58.mohsin_khan: And those who believe in the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord,
58.arberry: and those who believe in the signs of their Lord

59.sahih_international: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
59.pickthall: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,
59.yusuf_ali: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord;
59.shakir: And those who do not associate (aught) with their Lord,
59.muhammad_sarwar: who consider nothing equal to their Lord,
59.mohsin_khan: And those who join not anyone (in worship) as partners with their Lord;
59.arberry: and those who associate naught with their Lord

60.sahih_international: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
60.pickthall: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,
60.yusuf_ali: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord;-
60.shakir: And those who give what they give (in alms) while their hearts are full of fear that to their Lord they must return,
60.muhammad_sarwar: who spend their property for the cause of God, and whose hearts are afraid of their return
60.mohsin_khan: And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear (whether their alms and charities, etc., have been accepted or not), because they are sure to return to their Lord (for reckoning).
60.arberry: and those who give what they give, their hearts quaking that they are returning to their Lord --

61.sahih_international: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
61.pickthall: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.
61.yusuf_ali: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them.
61.shakir: These hasten to good things and they are foremost in (attaining) them.
61.muhammad_sarwar: to God, these are the ones who really compete with each other in virtuous deeds and are the foremost ones in the task.
61.mohsin_khan: It is these who race for the good deeds, and they are foremost in them [e.g. offering the compulsory Salat (prayers) in their (early) stated, fixed times and so on].
61.arberry: those vie in good works, outracing to them.

62.sahih_international: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
62.pickthall: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
62.yusuf_ali: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
62.shakir: And We do not lay on any soul a burden except to the extent of its ability, and with Us is a book which speaks the truth, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly.
62.muhammad_sarwar: We do not impose on any soul what is beyond its capacity. We have the Book which speaks the truth and no injustice will be done to it.
62.mohsin_khan: And We tax not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.
62.arberry: We charge not any soul save to its capacity, and with Us is a Book speaking truth, and they shall not be wronged.

63.sahih_international: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,
63.pickthall: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;
63.yusuf_ali: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do,-
63.shakir: Nay, their hearts are in overwhelming ignorance with respect to it and they have besides this other deeds which they do.
63.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, the hearts of the unbelievers are in the dark because of their ignorance of real virtue; they act against it.
63.mohsin_khan: Nay, but their hearts are covered (blind) from understanding this (the Quran), and they have other (evil) deeds, besides, which they are doing.
63.arberry: Nay, but their hearts are in perplexity as to this, and they have deeds besides that that they are doing.

64.sahih_international: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.
64.pickthall: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.
64.yusuf_ali: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication!
64.shakir: Until when We overtake those who lead easy lives among them with punishment, lo! they cry for succor.
64.muhammad_sarwar: But when We will strike with torment those (unbelievers) who are rich, they will start to cry for help.
64.mohsin_khan: Until, when We grasp those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment, behold! They make humble invocation with a loud voice.
64.arberry: Till, when We seize with the chastisement the ones of them that live at ease, behold, they groan.

65.sahih_international: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
65.pickthall: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.
65.yusuf_ali: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us.
65.shakir: Cry not for succor this day; surely you shall not be given help from Us.
65.muhammad_sarwar: We shall tell them, "Do not cry for help on this day; you will receive none from Us".
65.mohsin_khan: Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly, you shall not be helped by Us.
65.arberry: 'Groan not today; surely you shall not be helped from Us.

66.sahih_international: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
66.pickthall: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,
66.yusuf_ali: "My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels-
66.shakir: My communications were indeed recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels,
66.muhammad_sarwar: Our revelations had certainly been recited to you, but you turned your backs to them
66.mohsin_khan: Indeed My Verses used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels (denying them, and with hatred to listen to them).
66.arberry: My signs were recited to you, but upon your heels you withdrew,

67.sahih_international: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
67.pickthall: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.
67.yusuf_ali: "In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur'an), like one telling fables by night."
67.shakir: In arrogance; talking nonsense about the Quran, and left him like one telling fables by night.
67.muhammad_sarwar: and arrogantly mocked and reviled them.
67.mohsin_khan: In pride (they Quraish pagans and polytheists of Makkah used to feel proud that they are the dwellers of Makkah sanctuary Haram), talking evil about it (the Quran) by night.
67.arberry: waxing proud against it, talking foolish talk by night.'

68.sahih_international: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
68.pickthall: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
68.yusuf_ali: Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
68.shakir: Is it then that they do not ponder over what is said, or is it that there has come to them that which did not come to their fathers of old?
68.muhammad_sarwar: Was it that you did not give any thought to it (the Quran)? Was it different from what was revealed to your fathers?
68.mohsin_khan: Have they not pondered over the Word (of Allah, i.e. what is sent down to the Prophet SAW), or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old?
68.arberry: Have they not pondered the saying, or came there upon them that which came not upon their fathers, the ancients?

69.sahih_international: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
69.pickthall: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him?
69.yusuf_ali: Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him?
69.shakir: Or is it that they have not recognized their Apostle, so that they deny him?
69.muhammad_sarwar: Or did you not recognize your Messenger and, thus, denied him (Muhammad)
69.mohsin_khan: Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger (Muhammad SAW) so they deny him?
69.arberry: Or did they not recognise their Messenger and so denied him?

70.sahih_international: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
70.pickthall: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.
70.yusuf_ali: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
70.shakir: Or do they say: There is madness in him? Nay! he has brought them the truth, and most of them are averse from the truth.
70.muhammad_sarwar: or you said that he is possessed by satan? In fact, he has brought you the truth, but most of you dislike it.
70.mohsin_khan: Or say they: "There is madness in him?" Nay, but he brought them the truth [i.e. "(A) Tauhid: Worshipping Allah Alone in all aspects (B) The Quran (C) The religion of Islam,"] but most of them (the disbelievers) are averse to the truth.
70.arberry: Or do they say, 'He is bedevilled'? Nay, he has brought them the truth, but most of them are averse from the truth.

71.sahih_international: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
71.pickthall: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.
71.yusuf_ali: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition.
71.shakir: And should the truth follow their low desires, surely the heavens and the earth and all those who are therein would have perished. Nay! We have brought to them their reminder, but from their reminder they turn aside.
71.muhammad_sarwar: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens and the earth and all that is in them would have been destroyed. We sent them the Quran but they ignored it.
71.mohsin_khan: And if the truth had been in accordance with their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder, but they turn away from their reminder.
71.arberry: Had the truth followed their caprices, the heavens and the earth and whosoever in them is had surely corrupted. Nay, We brought them their Remembrance, but from their Remembrance they turned.

72.sahih_international: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
72.pickthall: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.
72.yusuf_ali: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
72.shakir: Or is it that you ask them a recompense? But the recompense of your Lord is best, and He is the best of those who provide sustenance.
72.muhammad_sarwar: (Do they disbelieve because) you asked them for payment? The reward that you will receive from your Lord is the best. He is the best Provider.
72.mohsin_khan: Or is it that you (O Muhammad SAW) ask them for some wages? But the recompense of your Lord is better, and He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
72.arberry: Or dost thou ask them for tribute? Yet the tribute of thy Lord is better, and He is the best of providers.

73.sahih_international: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
73.pickthall: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.
73.yusuf_ali: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way;
73.shakir: And most surely you invite them to a right way.
73.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), you certainly have called them to the right path,
73.mohsin_khan: And certainly, you (O Muhammad SAW) call them to a Straight Path (true religion Islamic Monotheism).
73.arberry: Assuredly thou art calling them to a straight path;

74.sahih_international: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
74.pickthall: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.
74.yusuf_ali: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way.
74.shakir: And most surely those who do not believe in the hereafter are deviating from the way.
74.muhammad_sarwar: but those who disbelieve the life hereafter deviate from the right path.
74.mohsin_khan: And verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed deviating far astray from the Path (true religion Islamic Monotheism).
74.arberry: and surely they that believe not in the world to come are deviating from the path.

75.sahih_international: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
75.pickthall: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.
75.yusuf_ali: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro.
75.shakir: And if We show mercy to them and remove the distress they have, they would persist in their inordinacy, blindly wandering on.
75.muhammad_sarwar: Even if We were to grant them mercy and rescue them from hardship, they would still blindly persist in their rebellion.
75.mohsin_khan: And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
75.arberry: Did We have mercy on them, and remove the affliction that is upon them, they would persist in their insolence wandering blindly.

76.sahih_international: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
76.pickthall: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,
76.yusuf_ali: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)!-
76.shakir: And already We overtook them with chastisement, but they were not submissive to their Lord, nor do they humble themselves.
76.muhammad_sarwar: We struck them with torment, but they did not submit themselves to their Lord, nor did they make themselves humble
76.mohsin_khan: And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke (Allah) with submission to Him.
76.arberry: We already seized them with the chastisement, yet they abased not themselves to their Lord nor were they humble;

77.sahih_international: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
77.pickthall: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.
77.yusuf_ali: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein!
77.shakir: Until when We open upon them a door of severe chastisement, lo! they are in despair at it.
77.muhammad_sarwar: until We opened the gate of greater torment (death) and they suddenly found themselves in despair.
77.mohsin_khan: Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! They will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair.
77.arberry: until, when We open against them a door of terrible chastisement, lo, they are sore confounded at it.

78.sahih_international: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
78.pickthall: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
78.yusuf_ali: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
78.shakir: And He it is Who made for you the ears and the eyes and the hearts; little is it that you give thanks.
78.muhammad_sarwar: It is God who has created ears, eyes, and hearts for you. Little are the thanks that you give.
78.mohsin_khan: It is He, Who has created for you (the sense of) hearing (ears), sight (eyes), and hearts (understanding). Little thanks you give.
78.arberry: It is He who produced for you hearing, and eyes, and hearts; little thanks you show.

79.sahih_international: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
79.pickthall: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.
79.yusuf_ali: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back.
79.shakir: And He it is Who multiplied you in the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered.
79.muhammad_sarwar: It is God who has settled you on the earth and before Him you will all be assembled.
79.mohsin_khan: And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back.
79.arberry: It is He who scattered you in the earth, and to Him you shall be mustered.

80.sahih_international: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
80.pickthall: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense?
80.yusuf_ali: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand?
80.shakir: And He it is Who gives life and causes death, and (in) His (control) is the alternation of the night and the day; do you not then understand?
80.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who gives life and causes death and it is He who alternates night and day. Will you not then understand?
80.mohsin_khan: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand?
80.arberry: It is He who gives life, and makes to die, and to Him belongs the alternation of night and day; what, will you not understand?

81.sahih_international: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
81.pickthall: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;
81.yusuf_ali: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said.
81.shakir: Nay, they say the like of what the ancients said:
81.muhammad_sarwar: They say exactly the same thing as the people who lived before.
81.mohsin_khan: Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said.
81.arberry: Nay, but they said the like of what the ancients said.

82.sahih_international: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
82.pickthall: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
82.yusuf_ali: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
82.shakir: They say: What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we then be raised?
82.muhammad_sarwar: They say, "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up again?
82.mohsin_khan: They said: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?
82.arberry: They said, 'What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be indeed raised up?

83.sahih_international: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
83.pickthall: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.
83.yusuf_ali: "Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients!"
83.shakir: Certainly we are promised this, and (so were) our fathers aforetime; this is naught but stories of those of old.
83.muhammad_sarwar: Our fathers and we have been given such promises before. These are no more than ancient legends."
83.mohsin_khan: "Verily, this we have been promised, we and our fathers before (us)! This is only the tales of the ancients!"
83.arberry: We and our fathers have been promised this before; this is naught but the fairy-tales of the ancients.'

84.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
84.pickthall: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge?
84.yusuf_ali: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein? (say) if ye know!"
84.shakir: Say: Whose is the earth, and whoever is therein, if you know?
84.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say to them, "Tell me, if you know, to whom does the earth and its contents belong?"
84.mohsin_khan: Say: "Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know!"
84.arberry: Say: 'Whose is the earth, and whoso is in it, if you have knowledge?'

85.sahih_international: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
85.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember?
85.yusuf_ali: They will say, "To Allah!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition?"
85.shakir: They will say: Allah's. Say: Will you not then mind?
85.muhammad_sarwar: They will quickly reply, "It belongs to God." Say, "Will you not, then, take heed?"
85.mohsin_khan: They will say: "It is Allah's!" Say: "Will you not then remember?"
85.arberry: They will say, God's.' Say: 'Will you not then remember?'

86.sahih_international: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
86.pickthall: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?
86.yusuf_ali: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme?"
86.shakir: Say: Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the mighty dominion?
86.muhammad_sarwar: Ask them, "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Great Throne?"
86.mohsin_khan: Say: "Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne?"
86.arberry: Say: 'Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the mighty Throne?'

87.sahih_international: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
87.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?
87.yusuf_ali: They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe?"
87.shakir: They will say: (This is) Allah's. Say: Will you not then guard (against evil)?
87.muhammad_sarwar: They will quickly say, "It is God." Say, "Will you not then have fear of Him?"
87.mohsin_khan: They will say: "Allah." Say: "Will you not then fear Allah (believe in His Oneness, obey Him, believe in the Resurrection and Recompense for each and every good or bad deed)."
87.arberry: They will say, 'God's.' Say: 'Will you not then be godfearing?'

88.sahih_international: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
88.pickthall: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge?
88.yusuf_ali: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects (all), but is not protected (of any)? (say) if ye know."
88.shakir: Say: Who is it in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things and Who gives succor, but against Him Succor is not given, if you do but know?
88.muhammad_sarwar: Ask them, "If you have any knowledge, in whose hands is the ownership of all things? Who is the one who gives protection and yet He Himself is never protected?"
88.mohsin_khan: Say "In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything (i.e. treasures of each and everything)? And He protects (all), while against Whom there is no protector, (i.e. if Allah saves anyone none can punish or harm him, and if Allah punishes or harms anyone none can save him), if you know." [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi, Vol. 12, Page 145]
88.arberry: Say: 'In whose hand is the dominion of everything, protecting and Himself unprotected, if you have knowledge?'

89.sahih_international: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
89.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched?
89.yusuf_ali: They will say, "(It belongs) to Allah." Say: "Then how are ye deluded?"
89.shakir: They will say: (This is) Allah's. Say: From whence are you then deceived?
89.muhammad_sarwar: They will reply spontaneously, "It is God." Ask them, "Why has falsehood bewitched you?"
89.mohsin_khan: They will say: "(All that belongs) to Allah." Say: "How then are you deceived and turn away from the truth?"
89.arberry: They will say, 'God's.' Say: 'How then are you bewitched?

90.sahih_international: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
90.pickthall: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.
90.yusuf_ali: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood!
90.shakir: Nay! We have brought to them the truth, and most surely they are liars.
90.muhammad_sarwar: We have sent them the truth and they, certainly, are liars.
90.mohsin_khan: Nay, but We have brought them the truth (Islamic Monotheism), and verily, they (disbelievers) are liars.
90.arberry: Nay, but We brought them the truth and they are truly liars.

91.sahih_international: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].
91.pickthall: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.
91.yusuf_ali: No son did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him!
91.shakir: Never did Allah take to Himself a son, and never was there with him any (other) god-- in that case would each god have certainly taken away what he created, and some of them would certainly have overpowered others; glory be to Allah above what they describe!
91.muhammad_sarwar: God has never given birth to a son and there is no other god besides Him. If there were, each god would have taken away his creatures and claimed superiority over the others. God is too exalted to be as they believe Him to be.
91.mohsin_khan: No son (or offspring or children) did Allah beget, nor is there any ilah (god) along with Him; (if there had been many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified be Allah above all that they attribute to Him!
91.arberry: God has not taken to Himself any son, nor is there any god with Him; for then each god would have taken off that he created and some of them would have risen up over others; glory to be God, beyond that they describe,

92.sahih_international: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
92.pickthall: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!
92.yusuf_ali: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him!
92.shakir: The Knower of the unseen and the seen, so may He be exalted above what they associate (with Him).
92.muhammad_sarwar: He has the knowledge of all seen and unseen things. He is too exalted to be considered equal to anything else.
92.mohsin_khan: All-Knower of the unseen and the seen! Exalted be He over all that they associate as partners to Him!
92.arberry: who has knowledge of the Unseen and the Visible; high exalted be He, above that they associate!

93.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
93.pickthall: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.
93.yusuf_ali: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me (in my lifetime) that which they are warned against,-
93.shakir: Say: O my Lord! if Thou shouldst make me see what they are threatened with:
93.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "Lord, if you will afflict them with punishment,
93.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): " My Lord! If You would show me that with which they are threatened (torment),
93.arberry: Say: 'O my Lord, if Thou shouldst show me that they are promised,

94.sahih_international: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
94.pickthall: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.
94.yusuf_ali: "Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong!"
94.shakir: My Lord! then place me not with the unjust.
94.muhammad_sarwar: exclude me from the unjust people".
94.mohsin_khan: "My Lord! Then (save me from Your Punishment), and put me not amongst the people who are the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doing)."
94.arberry: O my Lord, put me not among the people of the evildoers.'

95.sahih_international: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.
95.pickthall: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.
95.yusuf_ali: And We are certainly able to show thee (in fulfilment) that against which they are warned.
95.shakir: And most surely We are well able to make you see what We threaten them with.
95.muhammad_sarwar: We have the Power to strike them with torment before your very eyes.
95.mohsin_khan: And indeed We are Able to show you (O Muhammad SAW) that with which We have threatened them.
95.arberry: Assuredly, We are able to show thee that We promise them.

96.sahih_international: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
96.pickthall: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.
96.yusuf_ali: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say.
96.shakir: Repel evil by what is best; We know best what they describe.
96.muhammad_sarwar: Respond to the injustice (done to you) with the better deed. We know best what they attribute to God.
96.mohsin_khan: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best-Acquainted with the things they utter.
96.arberry: Repel thou the evil with that which is fairer. We Ourselves know very well that they describe.

97.sahih_international: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
97.pickthall: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,
97.yusuf_ali: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones.
97.shakir: And say: O my Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from the evil suggestions of the Shaitans;
97.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "Lord, I seek your protection against the strong temptations of the devils.
97.mohsin_khan: And say: "My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayatin (devils).
97.arberry: And say: 'O my Lord, I take refuge in Thee from the evil suggestions of the Satans,

98.sahih_international: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
98.pickthall: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,
98.yusuf_ali: "And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me."
98.shakir: And I seek refuge in Thee! O my Lord! from their presence.
98.muhammad_sarwar: I seek your protection should they approach me."
98.mohsin_khan: "And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they may attend (or come near) me."
98.arberry: and I take refuge in Thee, O my Lord, lest they attend me.'

99.sahih_international: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
99.pickthall: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,
99.yusuf_ali: (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back (to life),-
99.shakir: Until when death overtakes one of them, he says: Send me back, my Lord, send me back;
99.muhammad_sarwar: When death approaches one of the unbelievers, he says, "Lord, send me back again
99.mohsin_khan: Until, when death comes to one of them (those who join partners with Allah), he says: "My Lord! Send me back,
99.arberry: Till, when death comes to one of them, he says, 'My Lord, return me;

100.sahih_international: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
100.pickthall: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.
100.yusuf_ali: "In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up.
100.shakir: Haply I may do good in that which I have left. By no means! it is a (mere) word that he speaks; and before them is a barrier until the day they are raised.
100.muhammad_sarwar: so that perhaps I shall act righteously for the rest of my life." Although he will say so but his wish will never come true. After death they will be behind a barrier until the day of their resurrection.
