100.mohsin_khan: "So that I may do good in that which I have left behind!" No! It is but a word that he speaks, and behind them is Barzakh (a barrier) until the Day when they will be resurrected.
100.arberry: haply I shall do righteousness in that I forsook.' Nay, it is but a word he speaks; and there; behind them, is a barrier until the day that they shall be raised up.

101.sahih_international: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
101.pickthall: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.
101.yusuf_ali: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another!
101.shakir: So when the trumpet is blown, there shall be no ties of relationship between them on that day, nor shall they ask of each other.
101.muhammad_sarwar: There will be no kindred relations nor any opportunity to ask about others or seek their assistance after the trumpet has sounded.
101.mohsin_khan: Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another.
101.arberry: For when the Trumpet is blown, that day there shall be no kinship any more between them, neither will they question one another.

102.sahih_international: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
102.pickthall: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.
102.yusuf_ali: Then those whose balance (of good deeds) is heavy,- they will attain salvation:
102.shakir: Then as for him whose good deeds are preponderant, these are the successful.
102.muhammad_sarwar: If the side of ones good deeds weighs heavier on a scale, he will have everlasting happiness,
102.mohsin_khan: Then, those whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy, - these, they are the successful.
102.arberry: Then he whose scales are heavy -- they are the prosperers,

103.sahih_international: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
103.pickthall: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.
103.yusuf_ali: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide.
103.shakir: And as for him whose good deeds are light, these are they who shall have lost their souls, abiding in hell
103.muhammad_sarwar: but if it weighs less, one will be lost forever in hell.
103.mohsin_khan: And those whose scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who lose their ownselves, in Hell will they abide.
103.arberry: and he whose scales are light -- they have lost their souls in Gehenna dwelling forever,

104.sahih_international: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
104.pickthall: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.
104.yusuf_ali: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced.
104.shakir: The fire shall scorch their faces, and they therein shall be in severe affliction.
104.muhammad_sarwar: The fire will scorch their faces and they will be groaning therein in pain.
104.mohsin_khan: The Fire will burn their faces, and therein they will grin, with displaced lips (disfigured).
104.arberry: the Fire smiting their faces the while they glower there.

105.sahih_international: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
105.pickthall: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them?
105.yusuf_ali: "Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood?"
105.shakir: Were not My communications recited to you? But you used to reject them.
105.muhammad_sarwar: (They will be told), "Were Our revelations not recited to you and did you not call them lies?"
105.mohsin_khan: "Were not My Verses (this Quran) recited to you, and then you used to deny them?"
105.arberry: 'What, were My signs not recited to you, and you cried them lies?'

106.sahih_international: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
106.pickthall: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.
106.yusuf_ali: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray!
106.shakir: They shall say: O our Lord! our adversity overcame us and we were an erring people:
106.muhammad_sarwar: They will reply, "Lord, our hard-heartedness overcame us and we went astray.
106.mohsin_khan: They will say: "Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were (an) erring people.
106.arberry: They shall say, 'Our Lord, our adversity prevailed over us; we were an erring people.

107.sahih_international: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
107.pickthall: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.
107.yusuf_ali: "Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return (to Evil), then shall we be wrong-doers indeed!"
107.shakir: O our Lord! Take us out of it; then if we return (to evil) surely we shall be unjust.
107.muhammad_sarwar: Lord, take us out of this and if we sin again, we shall certainly be unjust".
107.mohsin_khan: "Our Lord! Bring us out of this; if ever we return (to evil), then indeed we shall be Zalimun: (polytheists, oppressors, unjust, and wrong-doers, etc.)."
107.arberry: Our Lord, bring us forth out of it! Then, if we revert, we shall be evildoers indeed.'

108.sahih_international: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
108.pickthall: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.
108.yusuf_ali: He will say: "Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me!
108.shakir: He shall say: Go away into it and speak not to Me;
108.muhammad_sarwar: He will say, "Be quiet and say nothing."
108.mohsin_khan: He (Allah) will say: "Remain you in it with ignominy! And speak you not to Me!"
108.arberry: 'Slink you into it,' He shall say, 'and do not speak to Me.

109.sahih_international: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
109.pickthall: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;
109.yusuf_ali: "A part of My servants there was, who used to pray 'our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
109.shakir: Surely there was a party of My servants who said: O our Lord! we believe, so do Thou forgive us and have mercy on us, and Thou art the best of the Merciful ones.
109.muhammad_sarwar: There was a group of my servants among you who always prayed: Lord, forgive us and grant us mercy; You are the best of those who show mercy.
109.mohsin_khan: Verily! There was a party of My slaves, who used to say: "Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy!"
109.arberry: There is a party of My servants who said, "Our Lord, we believe; therefore forgive us, and have mercy on us, for Thou art the best of the merciful."

110.sahih_international: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
110.pickthall: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.
110.yusuf_ali: "But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them!
110.shakir: But you took them for a mockery until they made you forget My remembrance and you used to laugh at them.
110.muhammad_sarwar: "You mocked and laughed at them until you forgot all about Me.
110.mohsin_khan: But you took them for a laughingstock, so much so that they made you forget My Remembrance while you used to laugh at them!
110.arberry: But you took them for a laughing-stock, till they made you forget My remembrance, mocking at them.

111.sahih_international: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
111.pickthall: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.
111.yusuf_ali: "I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss..."
111.shakir: Surely I have rewarded them this day because they were patient, that they are the achievers.
111.muhammad_sarwar: On this day I have given them their reward for their exercising patience and it is they who have triumphed."
111.mohsin_khan: Verily! I have rewarded them this Day for their patience, they are indeed the ones that are successful.
111.arberry: Now today I have recompensed them for their patient endurance; they are the triumphant.'

112.sahih_international: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
112.pickthall: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years?
112.yusuf_ali: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth?"
112.shakir: He will say: How many years did you tarry in the earth?
112.muhammad_sarwar: God will ask them, "How many years did you live in your graves?"
112.mohsin_khan: He (Allah) will say: "What number of years did you stay on earth?"
112.arberry: He shall say, 'How long have you tarried in the earth, by number of years?'

113.sahih_international: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
113.pickthall: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!
113.yusuf_ali: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account."
113.shakir: They will say: We tarried a day or part of a day, but ask those who keep account.
113.muhammad_sarwar: They will reply. "We remained for about a day or part of it, but ask those who have kept count".
113.mohsin_khan: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep account."
113.arberry: They shall say, 'We have tarried a day, or part of a day; ask the numberers!'

114.sahih_international: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
114.pickthall: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.
114.yusuf_ali: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known!
114.shakir: He will say: You did tarry but a little-- had you but known (it):
114.muhammad_sarwar: God will say, "You have indeed remained there for a short time. Would that you knew it during your life time.
114.mohsin_khan: He (Allah) will say: "You stayed not but a little, if you had only known!
114.arberry: He shall say, 'You have tarried but a little, did you know.

115.sahih_international: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
115.pickthall: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us?
115.yusuf_ali: "Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us (for account)?"
115.shakir: What! did you then think that We had created you in vain and that you shall not be returned to Us?
115.muhammad_sarwar: Did you think that We had created you for a playful purpose and that you were not to return to Us?"
115.mohsin_khan: "Did you think that We had created you in play (without any purpose), and that you would not be brought back to Us?"
115.arberry: What, did you think that We created you only for sport, and that you would not be returned to Us?'

116.sahih_international: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
116.pickthall: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.
116.yusuf_ali: Therefore exalted be Allah, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour!
116.shakir: So exalted be Allah, the True King; no god is there but He, the Lord of the honorable dominion.
116.muhammad_sarwar: God is the most exalted King and the Supreme Truth. He is the only God and the Lord of the Gracious Throne.
116.mohsin_khan: So Exalted be Allah, the True King, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!
116.arberry: Then high exalted be God, the King, the True! There is no god but He? the Lord of the noble Throne.

117.sahih_international: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
117.pickthall: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.
117.yusuf_ali: If anyone invokes, besides Allah, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through!
117.shakir: And whoever invokes with Allah another god-- he has no proof of this-- his reckoning is only with his Lord; surely the unbelievers shall not be successful.
117.muhammad_sarwar: One who worships things besides God has no proof of the authority of such things. God is certainly keeping the record of his deeds. The unbelievers will not have everlasting happiness.
117.mohsin_khan: And whoever invokes (or worships), besides Allah, any other ilah (god), of whom he has no proof, then his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely! Al-Kafirun (the disbelievers in Allah and in the Oneness of Allah, polytheists, pagans, idolaters, etc.) will not be successful.
117.arberry: And whosoever calls upon another god with God, whereof he has no proof, his reckoning is with his Lord; surely the unbelievers shall not prosper.

118.sahih_international: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
118.pickthall: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
118.yusuf_ali: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
118.shakir: And say: O my Lord! forgive and have mercy, and Thou art the best of the Merciful ones.
118.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "Lord, forgive me and grant me mercy; You are the best of the Merciful Ones.
118.mohsin_khan: And say (O Muhammad SAW): "My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy!"
118.arberry: And say: 'My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for Thou art the best of the merciful.'
